name: outer_slot
code:
a = [1, 2]
b = a.copy()
a[0] = 99
print(a, b)

name: outer_append
code:
a = [1, 2]
b = a.copy()
a.append(3)
print(a, b)

name: del_elem
code:
a = [1, 2, 3]
b = a.copy()
del a[0]
print(a, b)

name: nested_deeper
code:
a = [[[1]]]
b = a.copy()
b[0][0].append(2)
print(a, b)

name: dict_slot
code:
d = {"k": 1}
e = d.copy()
d["k"] = 5
print(d, e)

name: two_copies
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a.copy()
c = a.copy()
b[0].append(2)
print(a, b, c)

name: copy_of_copy
code:
a = [[1]]
b = a.copy()
c = b.copy()
c[0].append(7)
print(a, b, c)
